collection.description: The collection (an index on Pinecone, a class on Weaviate). vector_list_collections lists them.

namespace.description: Pinecone: the namespace (empty: the default one). Weaviate: the tenant of a multi-tenant collection. Milvus: the partition. Not used by Qdrant and Chroma.

items.description: A record id: text, or an integer where the store's ids are integers (Qdrant, Milvus with Int64 keys).

ids.description: The records to fetch. Leave out to page through the records a filter matches (or all of them).

filter.description: Records whose metadata match, in MongoDB's form: {"genre": "drama", "year": {"$gte": 2020}}. Operators $eq $ne $gt $gte $lt $lte $in $nin $exists, and $and / $or with a list. The store evaluates it; a field it doesn't index may be refused.

includeVectors.description: Also return each record's vector values.
